hero.title: Lodge a complaint about a government service
hero.subtitle: Tell a government department about a problem with a public service, then track its progress with the registration number you receive.

steps.title: Four steps to redress
steps.step1_desc: Choose the category and department, describe what happened, and add contact details.
steps.step2_desc: You get a unique reference number. Keep it to track progress.
steps.step3_desc: Officers examine the issue and update the status on your timeline.
steps.step4_desc: If you are not satisfied, you can ask for clarification or request an appeal.

notes.title: Before you begin
notes.free: This service is free of charge.
notes.contact: You will need a mobile number or email address to file a complaint.
notes.track: You can track a complaint using your registration number.
notes.department: If you are not sure which department to choose, you can still file the complaint and it will be sent to the right office.
notes.emergency: Do not use this in an emergency — call 112.

scope.title: Public service delivery problems
scope.intro: CPGRAMS is for grievances about public services provided by government departments.
scope.includes_title: You can use this service for
includes: Delays or failure in getting a public service
Problems with pensions, benefits or welfare schemes
Issues with identity documents or certificates
Poor quality of a government service you received
scope.excludes_title: Do not use this service for
excludes: Service matters of government employees (except those allowed by rules)

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: How do I file a grievance?
faq.a1: Choose File a complaint, enter your details, describe the problem, review, then submit. You will get a reference number.
faq.q2: How do I check my status?
faq.a2: Choose Track a complaint and enter the registration number you received after filing.
faq.q3: What is my grievance reference number?
faq.a3: It looks like CPG-2026-XXXXXX. Keep it safe — you need it to track your case.
faq.q4: What if I am not satisfied?
faq.a4: After a response, you can say you are not satisfied and request an appeal when that option is available.

footer.about: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System — Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances.
footer.help: Need help? Call 112 only for emergencies. For this portal, use Track a complaint with your reference number.

fileComplaint.title: File a complaint
fileComplaint.intro: Tell us what went wrong. This service is free. Do not use it in an emergency — call 112.
fileComplaint.categoryHint: Choose the option that best matches your problem
fileComplaint.departmentHint: If you are not sure, choose “I am not sure”

departments.darpg: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances
departments.health: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

fileComplaint.subject: Subject
fileComplaint.subjectHint: For example, “Pension not received for 3 months”
fileComplaint.detailsHint: Include dates, places and what you have already done
fileComplaint.documentsHint: PDF, JPG or PNG. Max 5 files, 5 MB each. Files are listed for review; your teammate will connect storage later.
fileComplaint.reviewIntro: Confirm these details before you submit. You can go back to change them.
fileComplaint.successIntro: Keep this reference number safe. You will need it to track your complaint.
fileComplaint.apiError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

track.title: Check grievance status
track.intro: Enter the reference number you received when you filed the complaint.
track.subject: Subject
track.noResponse: No response from the department yet.
track.nextReceived: Wait for the department to start examining your case. You can check again later with this reference number.
track.nextReview: The department is examining your case. Check back for a response.
track.nextResolved: If you are satisfied, you can close this matter. If not, you may request an appeal when that option is available.
track.nextRejected: If you are not satisfied, you may request an appeal when that option is available.
